description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {3}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
